Tom borrowed a book about science from the park. It takes twenty minutes to get to the subway station by bike. Last Friday, Tom and Nina went to the subway station. My shopping cart holds three items.
Tom thinks science is interesting but a little difficult. The subway station is one of the best places in the city. Tom wrote about the day in the diary. Also, scaffold wrapped the tower for a year.
Nina is interested in swimming. Tom plays volleyball with Nina every Friday. They took many photos at the corner store. In fact, the conversion of the old barn took two years.
The weather was rainy that day. Tom bought a hat at the shop yesterday. Tom and Nina had great fun there.
